## [3.60.11] - 2026-08-10

### Bug Fixes

- persist active loyalty redemptions across park/resume
- address code-review findings on loyalty redemption changes
- preserve redeemed points after payment
- ensure loyalty redemption discounts do not exceed cart subtotal
- persist isManualPriceOverride across cart park/resume snapshot
- prevent duplicate loyalty redemption reversal on concurrent cancel
- don't disable price-ceiling/discount checks on zero-price override lines
- preserve manual zero-price override across customer/pricelist change
- reverse loyalty point redemptions cancelled before payment

### Other Changes

- Guard in-memory pending refunds
- Fix refund line tracking for general items
- Fix receipt discount display base
- Address refund salesperson and close lock review
- Format gift card keyboard entry
- Fix refund draft lifecycle and close register overlay
- prevent duplicate active refund drafts
- allow Shva close dialogs above register overlay
- add global register closing overlay
- fix refund general items and salesperson sync
